correctness.rationale: For real ell_p(I), |I|≥3 and 2≤p<∞, D:R^4→R^6 maps a_i to a_i-a_j over all pairs. The exact D*D=4I-J has spectral norm 2 and maximum row l1 norm 2, hence by Riesz–Thorin ||D||_{p→p}≤2 for 2≤p≤∞; (1,1,-1,-1) attains 2 throughout. Coordinatewise application to four unit vectors gives Σ_{i<j}||x_i-x_j||_p^p≤4·2^p. The power-mean inequality on six distances bounds the squared-distance energy by 24(2/3)^{2/p}, attained simultaneously in both inequalities by four zero-sum three-coordinate sign-tetrahedral vectors with equal pairwise distance 2(2/3)^{1/p}. At p=∞ the trivial pairwise bound2 and same sign tetrahedron yield 24. Strict dimension jump over planar 8(1+2^{1-2/p}) for 2<p<∞ follows from strict concavity of t^{1-2/p}. Independent exact K4 Gram and numerical equality checks confirm normalization; all-p theorem is analytic interpolation, not experiment.
residual_risks: Requires real scalars and at least three coordinates; does not claim sharp formula for higher dimensional 1<p<2.
